units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 10:15">Targ. Ex. X, 15</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 13:49">Targ. Lev. XIII, 49</cite> (h. text <cite ref="J00667"><he>ירקרק</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Chullin 62a:6">Ḥull. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>בדירוק׳ כרסה</he> as regards the bird whose belly is green.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 30b:9">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בין חיורא בין אוכמא ובין י׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>יורקי</he>) whether white, dark or green (glazed).—Pl. <he>יְרוֹקִין</he>, <he>יְרוֹקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 30b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>בעו מיניה י׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="J00245"><he>יורקא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 9:3">Targ. Gen. IX, 3</cite>, a. e. <he>יְרוֹק עסבא</he>.—
<cite ref="Arakhin 31b:36">Arakh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא קדים אכיל י׳ וכ׳</he> I ate grass before thee (am older); a. e.—Pl. constr. <he>יְרוֹקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:30">Targ. Y. Gen. I, 30</cite> <he>י׳ עסבין</he>.

senses.gloss: (v. יֶרֶק) name of a species of fish (green fish).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:7:1">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="A02520"><he>אַסְפְּרוֹן</he></cite>.
